title: Support for Sports Not Affiliated with National Sports Associations
what_it_is: Support for Sports Not Affiliated with National Sports Associations

sections.label: Support for developing sports
sections.summary: Sport Singapore works with groups in developing sports that promote active lifestyles and cohesion, citing an Ultimate Frisbee competition with over 100 students from about 10 schools.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Many sports in Singapore are already supported by one of the 63 National Sports Associations (NSAs) recognised by Sport Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: However, there are other developing sports which have not fulfilled the criteria to be accorded NSA status.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: In cases where such sports help to promote an active lifestyle and build a more cohesive society, Sport Singapore will work with the respective groups to grow and develop the sport to provide more sporting opportunities and options for all.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: More than 100 students from about 10 Page: 9 schools took part in the ActiveSG Ultimate Frisbee Competition in November last year.

sections.label: Supporting emerging new sports
sections.summary: MCCY and Sport Singapore will continue to consider how best to support new and developing sports so more Singaporeans can live better through sport.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: As new sports emerge and develop, MCCY and Sport Singapore will continue to consider how best to support these sports, so that more Singaporeans can live better through sport.

sections.label: Inclusive approach and representation
sections.summary: The approach is inclusive and prepared to work with many sports without NSAs, but representing Singapore in specific competitions needs a more considered reply.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: The answer is one that is very inclusive and we are quite prepared to work with many sports, even though they have not formed NSAs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: But when it comes to representing Singapore in specific competitions, that is where I think there should be a more considered reply.

sections.label: Budget and support considerations
sections.summary: Considerations determine support level because with a limited budget, financial support should promote expertise and a talent pipeline without spreading resources too thinly.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: All these considerations will determine the level of support because working with a limited budget, we want to see that our financial support go towards promoting a level of expertise and a pipeline of talent development, so that resources are not too spread out such that they become episodic and do not promote a continuous pursuit of excellence.
